condition_source.GT_scope: Offline counts only, through the frozen 33-17 Y7 visible-instance count ratio, for grid, dataset choices and R8 predictions. No pose result, AP or output composition is used. Inference reads detections only.

E2a.selection: Keep 0.2. For each target in order, take the nearest remaining grid value by absolute median difference, breaking ties by lower threshold. If the target falls outside the achieved range, take the available endpoint. Record coincident achieved ratio levels, unattainable targets and any non-nested retained pools.
E2a.reuse: Register each distinct mask hash once, including all S/G seen at any chosen threshold. Rebuild augmentation and jointly score independently at every chosen threshold.

E2b.selection: Rank the five dataset medians (tie by dataset code), take first and last. Preregister predictions before pose work.
